output: Arrr, me hearty! For a true pirate's dinner, ye best serve up some hearty cuts of meat, plenty of fish fillets, and a side of fresh vegetables like carrots or potatoes. Don't forget yer favorite condiments like ketchup, mayonnaise, or hot sauce to make it taste just right! And if ye want the ultimate pirate meal, try somethin' savory with a side of fruit for dessert - nothing says "I be a real live pirate!" like a sweet and sour apple pie.
